statement: Chlorophyll concentration increases with dilution rate in nutrient limiting conditions.

scores.rationale: The stylized fact (chlorophyll concentration increases with dilution rate in nutrient-limiting conditions) is explicitly listed as SF7 with a literature reference in snippet [1] from LoreMarq2010, confirming it is an established empirical pattern. Snippets [5] and [17] from Zonnefeld (1998) provide mechanistic and observational support: during nutrient-limited growth, chlorophyll cell quota increase with growth rate (dilution rate at steady state), driven by nutrient pool dynamics. Snippet [6] indirectly supports it via related chl:C behavior. No snippet contradicts the fact—snippets discussing decreases relate to light-limited conditions or irradiance (different stylized facts). Several snippets are off-topic (oyster farming, salps, corals). Overall the corpus consistently corroborates the fact, though direct quantitative supporting evidence is moderate rather than abundant.
